name: govtribe
description: Search government contracts, awards, and vendors directly from ChatGPT. GovTribe brings U.S. procurement intelligence into your AI workflow—find relevant opportunities across federal agencies; analyze vendor competition; explore teaming partners; and track agency spending patterns. Whether you're researching new markets, conducting competitive analysis, or preparing a proposal, get instant access to billions in public sector data without leaving your conversation.
